title: The Morning Digest: October 31, 2026
dek: Friday's settles were WTI Dec26 $104.12 (up $2.12) and Brent Dec26 $117.64 (up $2.76) on its expiry day, both the highest closes since end April, with Brent Jan27 at $113.43 as the new front contract and a $4.21 roll gap into Monday. December WCS at -$29.75 (ICE TMW settle, Oct 30) on 990 lots, the first volume backed tightening of the week, with the Houston spread at +$6.99. The Energy Department's award sheets name the reserve buyers, including 16.75 million barrels in one sale and 23.8 million in another, correcting the record carried here on Oct 30. Imperial Oil's third quarter ran Kearl at 282 kb/d gross through full outage days while its full year Kearl guide was trimmed. Cenovus reports Wednesday Nov 4. The diesel crack is $97.08.
